thread:
eva-customer: hey team — started getting 502s from hosted inference when uploading via the new guest SDK (v2). Happened ~09:12 UTC, request id x-req-9a7f.
alice-support: sorry to hear that — can you paste the SDK snippet or a curl repro? any headers like Transfer-Encoding?
eva-customer: using SDK streaming upload, chunks every ~1s, file ~12MB. header: Transfer-Encoding: chunked. error: 502, body: \"upstream terminated\", request-id x-req-9a7f. happens intermittently under moderate concurrency (~10 parallel uploads).
alice-support: can you try a direct curl with --data-binary and same headers so we can isolate SDK vs proxy?
eva-customer: attached curl sample: `curl -v -X POST https://api.redwoodai.com/v1/infer -H \"Authorization: Bearer ...\" -H \"Transfer-Encoding: chunked\" --data-binary @payload.json` -> 502. Also added response trace id X-Trace: tr-33b.
ben-sre: looking at logs for tr-33b — seeing large number of 502s from envoy with upstream_reset / no healthy upstream. Correlates with ingress queue length spike.
carla-eng: any recent deploys to ingress? last config change tightened inflight rate limiter thresholds (small patch on 2024-11-02). Could be slow-chunked streams holding connection slots.
ben-sre: log excerpt: `ingress: conn_queue_len=512 inflight=496 drop=16 rate_limiter=too_many_inflight` and envoy reports `RST_STREAM` on upstream. Also see many `503` from upstream before 502s cascade.
ingress-bot: alert: prod-us-east-1 edge-ingress-queue-saturation -> firing.
alice-support: thanks — escalating to eng-sre for triage, tagging @ben-sre and @carla-eng. Customer needs mitigation ASAP.
carla-eng: probable root: slow client chunking + stricter inflight caps -> queue fill -> upstream short-circuits -> envoy returns 502. Repro plan: run 10 clients streaming 1s-chunks, observe conn window and drop.
ben-sre: repro locally with a load generator, confirmed queue buildup and downstream resets. Also saw keepalive pool thrash when many half-open streams exist.
carla-eng: short-term mitigation options: 1) relax inflight limiter thresholds temporarily, 2) increase ingress connection window, 3) denylist offending SDK agent for short period, 4) ask customer to switch to non-chunked upload.
alice-support: shared workaround with customer: try non-chunked upload or reduce concurrency. Also asked for SDK agent id to identify traffic.
eva-customer: trying non-chunked now, will report. thanks.
ben-sre: applied temp throttle bump on prod-us-east-1 (increased inflight cap 2x) and drained slow connections, monitoring.
duke-bot: action: created incident INC-3456, playbook run: ingress-queue-ops. Link: https://internal/incident/INC-3456
carla-eng: I'll open a short-lived rollback PR to revert the rate-limiter tightening while we instrument SDK signals. Also adding X-SDK-Agent header recommendation for targeted throttling.
ben-sre: added a temporary rule to deprioritize requests with Transfer-Encoding: chunked and low X-SDK-Rate headers for 10m to clear backlog.
alice-support: informed customer about mitigation and ETA ~15m.
eva-customer: non-chunked upload succeeded, no 502s now. Appreciate the fast response :tada:
alice-support: great — marking workaround successful, will follow up with permanent fix.
carla-eng: follow-ups: 1) monitor ingress queue for similar patterns, 2) add telemetry for chunked uploads, 3) revert rate-limiter change with safer threshold and tests, 4) update SDK docs to recommend X-SDK-Agent header.
ben-sre: closing incident after 1h of stable metrics.
alice-support: closing thread after customer confirmation. Support ticket #4321 updated.
eva-customer: thanks everyone!
